mcItems.q: For a parallel-plate capacitor, what is the effect of increasing the plate area on capacitance?
op: Capacitance decreases
Capacitance remains unchanged
Capacitance increases
Capacitance is halved
mcItems.ex: For a parallel-plate capacitor, increasing plate area increases capacitance and increasing separation decreases capacitance. Increasing the plate area increases capacitance.

mcItems.q: What is the definition of electric current?
op: The rate at which charge passes through a surface.
The speed at which charge moves through a circuit.
The direction positive charge would move.
The speed of microscopic drift.
mcItems.ex: Electric current is the rate at which charge passes through a surface. The speed at which charge moves through a circuit is incorrect because current is defined by the rate of charge passage.

mcItems.q: What is the conventional direction for electric current?

The direction of the electric field.
The direction of the microscopic drift speed.
